challenges.argument: Dwell depends on being inside inspection, and bottom_center versus center can place the point on different sides of that zone boundary, so the never-still finding is sensitive to anchor choice.
With 100 ms sampling a strict 1500 ms cutoff leaves no tolerance for quantization and jitter, so a 20% shorter requirement tests whether the failure was borderline rather than robust.
A strict stillness threshold can label pixel jitter as motion and prevent any 1500 ms still period, while a doubled threshold tests whether a true stop was missed for that reason.
Dropping every other frame tests whether brief inter-frame tracking noise broke an otherwise continuous still period needed for the 1500 ms dwell.
